commit_message: Integrate ADR0155 visual validation with current main
pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation
pr_body:
## Summary

Keeps the ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation current-main compatible while preserving the newly merged ADR0143/0145/0154 deterministic AI Studio visual fixtures. The ADR0155 managed-local fixture now shares the current visual-scroll/evidence state instead of replacing it.

## Validation

Run Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation on the resulting exact HEAD.

## Remaining first-release evidence

ADR0155 still requires representative measured WindowsNative versus Wsl2Linux runtime characterization before one environment is treated as the normal product default.
